items.text: I kept seeing engineers share what they were building with AI; however, I was always more curious about how they worked. Which agents did they use? What skills and tools had stuck or been thrown out the window? How did they manage longer-running tasks?   So I built this with the hope we could have a dedicated space to share and be open about our setups.
